changeSet.author: kmcnamee
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER view [dbo].[IntersectTypeDetail] as select IT.Uid, IT.ID, IT.Subject, IT.SubjectID, IT.SubjectCardinality, case IT.Subject when 'IntersectType' then utility.DeriveIntersectTypeName(SIT.ID) when 'GroupType' then 'Group' when 'ResourceType' then 'Resource' else coalesce(SFT.TextPath, SATT.Name, SDT.Name) end as SubjectName, coalesce(SIcon.IconBackColor, '#000') as SubjectIconBackColor, coalesce(SIcon.IconForeColor, '#fff') as SubjectIconForeColor, coalesce(SIcon.IconText, substring(coalesce(SATT.Name, SDT.Name, ''), 1, 2)) as SubjectIconText,
IT.Object, IT.ObjectID, IT.ObjectCardinality, case IT.Object when 'IntersectType' then utility.DeriveIntersectTypeName(OIT.ID) when 'GroupType' then 'Group' when 'ResourceType' then 'Resource' else coalesce(OFT.TextPath, OATT.Name, ODT.Name) end as ObjectName, coalesce(OIcon.IconBackColor, '#000') as ObjectIconBackColor, coalesce(OIcon.IconForeColor, '#fff') as ObjectIconForeColor, coalesce(OIcon.IconText, substring(coalesce(OATT.Name, ODT.Name, ''), 1, 2)) as ObjectIconText,
IT.PredicateID, P.Name as [PredicateName], P.Inverse as PredicateInverse, P.Type as PredicateType,
coalesce(IT.IsSystem, cast(0 as bit)) as IsSystem from IntersectType IT with(nolock) left join [Predicate] P with(nolock) on P.ID = IT.PredicateID
left join [dbo].[AssetType] SATT with(nolock ) on SATT.[Object] = IT.Subject and SATT.ObjectID = IT.SubjectID and IT.Subject != 'FusionAttributeType' left join [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] SFT with(nolock ) on SFT.ID = IT.SubjectID and IT.Subject = 'FusionAttributeType' left join ( select 1 as ID, 'Reference List' as Name ) SDT on IT.Subject = 'ReferenceItemType' and IT.SubjectID = 0
left join IntersectType SIT with(nolock) on IT.Subject = 'IntersectType' and SIT.ID = IT.SubjectID
left join [dbo].[AssetType] OATT with(nolock ) on OATT.[Object] = IT.[Subject] and OATT.ObjectID = IT.SubjectID left join [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] OFT with(nolock ) on OFT.ID = IT.ObjectID and IT.Object = 'FusionAttributeType' left join dbo.IntersectType OIT with(nolock) on IT.Object = 'IntersectType' and OIT.ID = IT.ObjectID left join ( select 0 as ID, 'Reference List' as Name ) ODT on IT.Object = 'ReferenceItemType' and IT.ObjectID = 0
left join ObjectStyle SIcon with(nolock) on SIcon.ObjectType = IT.Subject and SIcon.ObjectID = IT.SubjectID left join ObjectStyle OIcon with(nolock) on OIcon.ObjectType = IT.Object and OIcon.ObjectID = IT.ObjectID where coalesce(SATT.ID, SDT.ID, SIT.ID) is not null and coalesce(OATT.ID,ODT.ID, OIT.ID) is not null
changeSet.rollback:
